Self-Designing Processor Architecture. Automatically explores chip layouts, instruction sets, memory structures, and accelerator designs.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 67 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Computing Beyond the Conventional Computer". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. AI chip design is real: Google's floorplanning RL and AlphaChip design TPU blocks; full autonomy is emerging.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Self-Designing Processor Architecture - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Automatically explores chip layouts, instruction sets, memory structures, and accelerator designs.
body:
Known science foundations of Self-Designing Processor Architecture.

Google used RL for chip floorplanning (Nature, 2021). AlphaChip designs production TPU blocks. Synopsys DSO.ai optimizes designs commercially. RISC-V enables ISA exploration. High-level synthesis compiles algorithms to hardware. Human architects still lead; AI accelerates exploration.

Key quantity check (Transistors on leading chips in billions / engineers on a design team): computed ratio 0.1 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.4. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Self-Designing Processor Architecture - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Automatically explores chip layouts, instruction sets, memory structures, and accelerator designs.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Self-Designing Processor Architecture.

AI designs need human verification. Manufacturing constraints are hard to encode fully. Novel architectures need software stacks.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 8 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is transistors vs design team at 8 orders of magnitude (transistors larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

description: Public edition: Automatically explores chip layouts, instruction sets, memory structures, and accelerator designs.
body:
Unresolved problems for Self-Designing Processor Architecture, in priority order (research burden index 12, 0 blocking):

Trusting AI layouts in production (severity 2/3, tractability 2/3; priority 4).

Encoding all DFM constraints (severity 2/3, tractability 2/3; priority 4).

Software for novel ISAs (severity 2/3, tractability 2/3; priority 4).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.
